final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin iout vdd vss
* Self-biased low-voltage cascode mirror (all gates on iin)
* Bottom pair: W/L=100, weak/moderate inversion -> saturates at ~0.08-0.1 V
M2 x2   iin vss vss nfet W=200 L=2
M1 x1   iin vss vss nfet W=200 L=2
* Cascode pair: W/L=3000 (~30x bottom) -> V(x) ~ Vt*ln(30) ~ 0.09 V
* Input cascode M3 copies the output-side bottom VDS -> accurate ratio
M3 iin  iin x2  vss nfet W=1500 L=0.5
* Output cascode M4 boosts rout by gm*ro (>> 1.2 Mohm)
M4 iout iin x1  vss nfet W=1500 L=0.5
.ends
